subject: Deku Scrubs
text: The three Deku Scrubs must be deflected and caught in the order 2, 3, 1 from left to right.

evidence.quote:
This is exactly what the Deku Scrub was talking about, there are 
three of them here and you have to catch them in the correct order.  That 
order was 2, 3, 1, from left to right.  So basically start by deflecting the 
Deku Nut back at the scrub in the middle, then the one on the far right and 
then the one on the far left.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Queen Gohma is stunned by firing a Deku Seed into her eye using the Fairy Slingshot, allowing Link to slash her with his sword.

evidence.quote:
Hold the L/Z button to target her eye and tap the Fairy Slingshot button to fire a Deku Seed right 
into it, stunning the boss.  While the boss is stunned, run up to her and 
begin to slash her with your sword as many times as you possibly can.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: When Queen Gohma drops three eggs from the ceiling, a single strike kills each egg before it hatches.

evidence.quote:
After 
a few seconds she will drop three eggs down directly below where she is on the 
ceiling.  You now have a small amount of time to go and strike those eggs, one 
single hit will kill them however if you are not fast enough they will hatch 
into those little one eyed enemies you fought before.

subject: Heart Container
text: Defeating Queen Gohma rewards a full Heart Container, increasing Link's hearts to four.

evidence.quote:
When the battle is over there is a full HEART CONTAINER [001].  Your hearts 
have now been increased to four, that's pretty nice.

subject: Kokiri's Emerald
text: The Deku Tree gives Link the Kokiri's Emerald after speaking to him.

evidence.quote:
Listen to 
everything the Deku Tree has to say because it's all very important.  After 
the tree speaks it gives you the KOKIRI'S EMERALD.

subject: Fairy Ocarina
text: Saria gives Link the Fairy Ocarina at the western exit of Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
Simply run all the way west to the exit of the forest, a scene will 
take place between Link and Saria.  She will give Link the FAIRY OCARINA.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula appears behind the house in the southwest corner of Kokiri Forest only at night and can be collected with a jump attack.

evidence.quote:
Your destination is the southwest corner, go up the slope that 
lead you before to the fenced are and the crawlspace, but this time ignore the 
fences and go around behind the house up here to find a Gold Skulltula....To use the jump attack hold down the L/Z button and press 
the A button, Link will jump into the air a little and it should give him just 
enough height to grab hold of that GOLD SKULLTULA [004].  This enemy only 
appears in the village at night which is why you could not come here and get 
it before.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Bazaar in Hyrule Market sells a shield, but players should avoid purchasing it since the same shield can be obtained for free soon after.

evidence.quote:
The only noteworthy thing 
they sell here is the new shield however don't bother purchasing it at all, 
you're going to get the same shield soon enough, and for free.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: The Shooting Gallery targets appear in order: 1 center green, 2 left blue, 3 right blue, 4 center jumping green, 5 left blue and 6 right blue simultaneously, 7 and 8 right-to-left red, and 9 and 10 fast left-to-right red.

evidence.quote:
1 - The first one appears directly in the middle of the screen, a green one....2 - The second one is a blue one that moves in from the left side of the 
    screen toward the middle and stays just a bit to the left....3 - The third one comes in from the right side of the screen toward the 
    middle and stays just a bit right of the middle, a blue one....4 - The fourth is a green one which pops out of the middle, up into the air
    and then drops down, hit it at the highest point of the jump....5 - The next one is a blue Rupees similar to the second one however it comes
    from the left near the middle at the same time as number six
6 - Comes in at the same time as number five but from the right side, you
    have to hit both of them before they both exit the screen....7 - This is a red Rupee which moves at a moderate speed from the right side of 
    the screen to the left side of the screen, it will not stop.
8 - This is a red Rupee which moves at a moderate speed from the right side of 
    the screen to the left side of the screen, it will not stop.
9 - This is another red one which this time moves from the left side of the
    screen to the right side of the screen, quite quickly so aim fast.
10 - This is another red one which this time moves from the left side of the
     screen to the right side of the screen, quite quickly so aim fast.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Bringing the white dog found left of the main entrance back to the lady in the first door in the Back Alley at night rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Your goal is to find the fat lady's dog.  It may be 
randomized but for me, her dog was the white dog just left of the main 
entrance to town, left when you are looking directly at the entrance....Enter the first door with the 
dog following you (to get the dog to follow you simply walk up to it) and 
inside this house is the lady.  Assuming you brought her the correct dog she 
will reward you with your first PIECE OF HEART [001].

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the large tree directly in front of the entrance to Hyrule Castle causes a Gold Skulltula to drop down.

evidence.quote:
Note the large tree directly in front of 
you, what you want to do is run up to this tree and hit the A button to roll 
right into it.  You'll here the secret noise and a Gold Skulltula will drop 
out of the tree.  Defeat the enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [005].

subject: Weird Egg
text: Speaking to Malon beside the vine outside Hyrule Castle grants the Weird Egg.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the young girl beside you, next to the vine.  Twice if need be.  She 
should give you the WEIRD EGG.

subject: Weird Egg
text: The Weird Egg hatches into a Chicken in the morning after waiting through the night.

evidence.quote:
Stand 
at the top of the vines and just let the game sit through the night (game 
night I mean, not all night.)  In the morning when you hear the rooster, the 
egg you have will hatch into a CHICKEN.

subject: Talon
text: Equipping and using the Chicken beside Malon's sleeping father wakes him up.

evidence.quote:
At the end of the path you will find 
Malon's father there, sleeping on the job.  Since you can't wake him up by 
speaking to him, stand beside him and equip the Chicken.  Press the C button 
which corresponds to the Chicken and he'll be up and about in no time.

subject: Waterfall Crawlspace
text: Pushing two blocks off the ledge so one stacks on top of the other allows Link to jump to the waterfall crawlspace during the daytime.

evidence.quote:
Grab both blocks and push them off this ledge and that will allow 
you to get up close to the waterfall.  After you've pushed one block over the 
edge and the other block on top of the other one you can climb up on top of it 
and jump toward the waterfall.  Press the A button to crawl in through the 
crawlspace, note that you must go during the day, night will not work here.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: The Shooting Gallery costs 20 Rupees for fifteen shots to shoot down ten Rupees, awarding a free game for hitting eight targets and a Bullet Bag carrying 40 Deku Seeds instead of 30 for hitting all ten.

evidence.quote:
What you have to do in the Shooting Gallery is pay 20 
Rupees in order to begin the game.  You are given fifteen shots and you have 
to shoot down ten Rupees....If you manage to hit eight out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded 
with a free game, if you manage to hit ten out of the ten targets then you 
will be rewarded with a BULLET BAG for your Deku Seeds, this allows you to 
carry 40 Deku Seeds for use with your Fairy Slingshot instead of 30, and is 
quite a helpful item.
